metadata.title: Rice Harvest
metadata.description:
After about seven months of sowing the paddy seeds using dibble sticks. In the beginning of winters, rice crops turn golden yellow and are ready to be harvested. In this short video I show you how they are harvested, tied in bundles, threshed and the grains are gathered. 

The rice grown is sufficient for the family for the entire year.
